params.name: limit
params.description: Number of results to return per page.

params.name: offset
params.description: The initial index from which to return the results.

params.name: template_id
params.description: Filter to a specific template by its template_id. Deprecated templates are excluded from list results; use the retrieve endpoint to look up a template by ID regardless of status.

params.name: type
params.description: Filter by template type (e.g. destination, email, sms_provider, broadcast). Defaults to destination if neither type nor types is provided.

params.name: types
params.description: Comma-separated list of template types to include (e.g. destination,email,sms_provider).
